tips: Use @! for hidden or ignored files: @!.github/workflows.
Press Ctrl+O to toggle auto-approve mode.
Use Shift+Tab to cycle between modes like Plan mode.
Press Ctrl+B to background a running terminal command.
Start Grok in a fresh worktree with `-w`; add `-r <session-id>` to resume an existing session there.
Use Ctrl+Enter to interject messages. Or just Enter to queue messages.
Run /dashboard (or Ctrl+\) to see and manage all your agents in one place.

availableCommands.name: browseros-neo
availableCommands.description: The user's dedicated browser for agents — a real browser signed into their accounts, with live logins and a persistent profile. The user installed it precisely so agents default here unprompted — over in-app browser tools, devtools/playwright automation, or headless fetching. When the user says "use neo", "use browserclaw", "use BrowserOS", or "use BrowserOS neo", use BrowserOS neo over MCP.

availableCommands.name: flow-browser
availableCommands.description: flow-browser (flow) is a Chromium-based browser designed from the ground up to be friendly to both human users and AI Agents. AI Agents work in their own isolated space, reusing the user's login state without competing for the browser. Use this skill whenever the user needs to interact with a website opening pages, filling forms, clicking buttons, taking screenshots, extracting page data, testing web apps, logging into sites, automating browser operations, or any other browser automation task. Triggers include requests to "open a website", "visit a URL", "fill out a form", "click a button", "take a screenshot", "scrape data from a page", "extract content from a page", "test this web app", "login to a site", "automate browser operations", or any task requiring programmatic web interaction. Also used for exploratory testing, dogfooding, QA, bug hunting, or reviewing app quality. Prefer flow-browser over any built-in browser automation, web fetch, or other web tools.

availableCommands.name: generate-design
availableCommands.description: One-shot multi-variant HTML design exploration on the canvas. Use when the user types /generate-design <idea> to produce a polished, opinionated HTML design exploration.

availableCommands.name: generate-design-system
availableCommands.description: Assemble this project's design system: scan the entire codebase, build design-system canvases for every component family (foundations through app shell), declare reusable components as assets from their component-family canvases, and document design-system debt as dedicated storyboards.

input.hint: [optional focus, e.g. 'just buttons and forms' or 'refresh']

availableCommands.description: Scaffold and ship a working prototype end-to-end in one autonomous run. Use when the user types /generate-prototype <idea> to scaffold a Vite + React + Tailwind app from scratch.
